query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM entry_timestamp) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM entry_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS visitor_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE person_type = 'visitor' AND entry_mode_value = 'land' AND NOT entry_timestamp IS NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM entry_timestamp) = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM entry_timestamp), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM entry_timestamp) ORDER BY month LIMIT 1200
